content:
A crash at the intersection of Eva Sámano and Perú, in Colonia La Fe in Nuevo Laredo, on Monday afternoon left three people slightly injured, including a five-month-old baby, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo. The injured were Yadira, 26, her five-month-old baby, and her mother Griselda, 50.

According to the report, a 1996 Toyota Camry driven by Efrén, 64, was traveling south to north on Eva Sámano and planned to turn left at Perú after another driver yielded, when it was struck in the intersection by a 2026 Kia traveling north to south. El Mañana identifies Efrén as the driver blamed for the crash, and says one vehicle then lost control and hit a CFE utility pole at a corner of the intersection. Efrén was reported unharmed.

Red Cross paramedics attended to Yadira, Griselda and the baby, the outlet reported. The report does not state that anyone was taken to a hospital.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Choque en Nuevo Laredo deja lesionadas a dos mujeres y un bebé," Oct. 27, 2026
